instagram.caption:
The inherited jar of mixed hardware.
The Fastener and Hardware Zone in the Workshop. Let you put your hand on the right screw straight away, so a project never stops for a hardware run.

What done looks like:
1. One fastener type
2. Size per compartment
3. With a sample screw glued to the outside of each drawer face so you match by eye rather than by reading. Deck screws separate from drywall screws
4. No coffee tin of mixed hardware anywhere on the shelf

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success fastener and hardware zone.
